assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key areas use provisional polygons; they are not official redlines or precise-area bases.
assumptions.impact: All spatial conclusions are directional and must be recalculated after official polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, heritage constraints, ownership and utilities remain unconfirmed.
assumptions.impact: No statutory control value is invented; related conclusions remain conceptual.

assumptions.statement: Building floors are proposal assumptions for catalytic demonstration projects only.
assumptions.impact: They do not represent existing building stock or approved FAR.
